tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Package estimate of Removal of jungle and silt from Km 60.00 to 89.00 of LBC and distributaries in selected reaches of LBC from Km 60.00 to 89.00 Km of GNP.

itemList.description: Cutting and removing jauliflora bushes above 1.50 m upto 3.00 m girth excluding removal of stumps and including burning or disposing off the materials as directed with all lead and all lifts. And as directed by the Engineer In Charge.

Excavation and removal of silt and silt mixed with sand from canal bed in dry condition including disposing off the same in spoil bank or on the canal embankment in layers as directed etc., complete with all lead and lifts. Engineer In Charge.
Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Engineer In Charge.
